description: Replace an article's title, meta description, slug or full HTML body. Send only the fields to change. The slug must be unique in the workspace, and a published article keeps its slug. Open tracked changes are dropped when the body changes. This saves the article in Rankwise; live_update and next_step in the result say how a published article's live post takes the edit. update_live_post updates the live post in place on WordPress (Rankwise plugin), Next.js (@rankwise/next), Rails (rankwise-rails), the webhook integration and Shopify. On the Rankwise-hosted blog and Framer a saved edit is already live (Framer at its next sync), so there is nothing to push. Webflow, Wix, Notion, Ghost and WordPress.com cannot update a live post from Rankwise: change the post in that CMS by hand. Free.

html.description: The full article body as HTML. It is sanitised: scripts, styles, frames, forms and event handlers are removed.

name: replace_article
title: Replace an article
